items.title: 8.16.1 Synthesis of ammonia by Haber's process (Haber process se ammonia banana) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.1, printed pages 183-184.

blocks.text: Industry ki basic (bunyadi) need yeh hai ke product ki zyada se zyada yield mile. Ammonia ke industrial banane mein zyada yield ke liye hum equilibrium ka concept istemal kar sakte hain.
Nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia banna reversible process hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is equation ke saath ΔH = −46.11 kJ mol⁻¹ likha hai. −46.11 kJ ek mole NH₃ banne ki enthalpy hai; equation mein 2NH₃ bante hain, is liye ΔH = 2 × (−46.11) = −92.2 kJ (Quick Check 8.6 ki table bhi −92 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai). Sign negative hi hai: reaction exothermic hai aur baqi results wahi hain.
Ammonia ki zyada se zyada yield in ways (tareeqon) se milti hai:

items: Time to time (waqtan fawaqtan) ammonia ko reaction vessel (bartan) se nikal kar us ki concentration kam karein. Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq equilibrium forward shift hoga.
Reactants ke 4 moles mil kar products ke 2 moles banate hain, yani reaction mein volume kam hota hai. Zyada pressure equilibrium ko right shift kar ke aur ammonia deta hai.
Yeh exothermic reaction hai. Temperature kam karne se Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq reaction forward shift hoti hai.

blocks.text: Neeche Table 8.1 aur Fig 8.4 dekh kar saaf hai ke pressure aur temperature ka ammonia ki yield par bohat gehra asar hai. Sab se complete conversion 473 K (200 °C) aur 1000 atmosphere par 98.3% hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Table 8.2' aur 'Figure 8.3' ka reference (hawala) deti hai; matlab Table 8.1 aur Fig 8.4 hain jo isi page par chhapi hain.

blocks.caption: Table (8.1): Effect of Temperature on Kc for Ammonia Synthesis.

blocks.alt: NH3 ki yield (%) 0 se 100 tak, temperature 200 se 700 °C ke muqable. Paanch girte curves: 1000 atm, 600 atm, 300 atm, 100 atm aur 10 atm. 200 °C par yield taqreeban 98, 95, 90, 81 aur 50 percent; temperature barhne par sab girti hain. Taqreeban 400 °C aur 43 percent par 100 atm aur 300 atm curves ke darmiyan ek chhota circle hai jis se arrow 'Industrial conditions' ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4: 5 pressures par temperature (°C) ke muqable ammonia ki percent yield. Bohat zyada pressure aur kam temperature (oopar baen) par yield zyada magar rate kam. Industrial conditions (circle): 200 se 300 atm, taqreeban 400 °C (hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har curve ek pressure ka hai: pressure jitna zyada, curve utna oopar, yani yield zyada. Har curve right taraf girta hai kyun ke reaction exothermic hai aur heat yield kam karti hai. Circle (daira) industrial conditions dikhata hai: 200 se 300 atm aur taqreeban 400 °C, jahan yield kam (taqreeban 40%) magar reaction kaafi tez hai.

200 °C par yield to zyada hai magar reaction bohat slow ho jati hai aur process uneconomical (mehnga) ho jata hai. Is liye temperature moderate (darmiyane) level, yani 400 °C, tak barhaya jata hai aur rate barhane ke liye catalyst istemal hota hai. Catalyst ke baghair wahi rate lene ke liye kahin zyada temperature chahiye, jo yield kam kar deta hai.
Optimum conditions to get best yield of ammonia (ammonia ki behtareen yield ki conditions)
Ammonia ki zyada se zyada yield ke liye suitable conditions yeh hain:

items: Catalyst: MgO, Al₂O₃ aur SiO₂ ke pighle (fused) mixture mein lohe (iron) ke crystals ke tukre
N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ exothermic hai aur gas moles 4 se 2 hote hain: yield zyada pressure, ammonia nikalne aur kam temperature se barhti hai (200 °C aur 1000 atm par 98.3%).
Kam temperature par reaction bohat slow hai, is liye 200-300 atm, taqreeban 673 K aur iron catalyst.
Kc 200 K par 7.15 × 10¹⁵ se 800 K par 3.96 × 10⁻² tak girta hai.
